- Hypertension, controlled with lisinopril 10mg daily
- Hyperlipidemia, managed with atorvastatin 20mg daily
- Appendectomy at age 25

- Vital Signs: BP 130/85, HR 78, RR 16, Temp 98.8°F

- MRI Lumbar Spine: Left paracentral disc extrusion at L4-L5 level, impinging on the left L5 nerve root.

2. Ischemic cardiomyopathy with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF)

The device implantation was performed by Dr. Michael Johnson on April 5, 2023, without complications. The patient tolerated the procedure well and was discharged on April 7, 2023, with instructions to follow up in the Arrhythmia Clinic in two weeks for a device check and programming.
